brief:
Israel carried out an 11-day escalated military assault on Hebron that forced thousands of Palestinians from their homes, Drop Site News reported. The operation resulted in mass displacement across the occupied West Bank city.

The scale of the forced displacement during the operation affected large numbers of Palestinian residents, though specific casualty figures and additional operational details were not immediately available.
dek: Thousands of Palestinians faced forced displacement during the duration of a heavy Israeli military operation on Hebron.
title: Israel conducts 11-day military operation in Hebron, displacing thousands
